workItem: Add a Free-tier-compatible compromised-password gate for CAPITAL-AI email/password registration and password recovery, enforced through the application backend with HIBP k-anonymity and protected by deployment-time invariants.
priorityReason: Supabase Free does not provide native leaked-password rejection; application signup and recovery need a compensating fail-closed control without weakening existing CAPTCHA/MFA/Supabase boundaries.
scopeNote: Security hardening only. No Supabase plan change, no provider IAM/secret mutation, no password storage/logging, no service-role exposure, no weakening of CAPTCHA/MFA. HIBP receives only a five-character SHA-1 prefix from the backend.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; automation has no merge authority.
releaseReason: PR #1162 merged on 2026-09-20. The compromised-password gate is implemented on main; this stale coordination claim is released.
